info.name: Dekago v2 - RSDK Ciamis Website Feeds
info.description:
The three public (no auth) dekago-v2 endpoints that rsdkciamis-website pulls every 15 minutes (server/dekagoSync.ts): jadwal dokter (+cuti), persediaan tempat tidur, jadwal operasi.

Set the `base_url` variable to the same value as DEKAGO_API_BASE_URL in the website's .env (e.g. https://<dekago-host>/api/v1/pasien, no trailing slash).

variable.description: Y-m-d. Empty = today (Asia/Jakarta), filled by pre-request script.
Y-m-d. Empty = from + 7 days (max range 14 days).

request.description: Weekly doctor schedule. data.jadwal_dokter is a 7-element array indexed by weekday (0 = Minggu); use the array index, not day_of_week/nama_hari. data.cuti = leave entries for today..today+6; data.jadwal_cuti_mingguan = slots whose weekly status is cuti. The website's zod schema rejects the response if cuti/jadwal_cuti_mingguan are missing.

response.name: 200 OK (shape)

request.description: Bed availability per kelas. The website stores occupied = max(0, total - tersedia); `total` may exceed tersedia + terpakai because reserved beds are not counted in terpakai. An empty list makes the website sync fail (old data kept).

exec: pm.test('each row has kelas, total, tersedia', () => rows.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.kelas).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(Number(r.total)).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(Number(r.tersedia)).to.be.at.least(0); }));

query.description: Y-m-d. Website sends today + 7. Max range 14 days.

request.description: Surgery schedule. With from+to, dekago calls SIMGOS once per day (slow: the website allows 120 s). Invalid params -> 422; any SIMGOS day failing -> 502 upstream_error.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('to')) { const d = new Date(pm.variables.get('from') + 'T00:00:00Z'); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 7); pm.variables.set('to', d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)); }
pm.test('rows have nama_dokter and tanggal (d/m/Y H:i)', () => rows.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.nama_dokter).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(r.tanggal).to.match(/^\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4} \d{2}:\d{2}/); }));

request.description: No from/to: newest ~100 SIMGOS records, cached 1 min. Used by dekago-app, not by the website sync.
Negative case. Also 422 for bad format, to < from, or range > 14 days.
